subject: Electron menu to New Game to flight to physical dock to Ledger smoke

failure.message: Main Menu must be visible — false !== true

classificationBasis: The harness's locator-based wait for [data-screen="mainMenu"] had already succeeded before the rejected predicate ran.
The failure screenshot visibly contains the complete Main Menu and its New Game control.
The failure snapshot recorded mode=menu, visibleScreens=[mainMenu], and active focus on the New Game button.
The false reading came from a second, separate querySelector visibility sample, making this a selector/stability false negative rather than a missing product surface.
The Electron canonical root stayed valid, the application exited with code 0, the listener was released, cleanup passed without force-close, and recorded page issues were warnings rather than errors.
The one-use sentinel recorded exactly one Electron launch and refuses a retry.
survivingClaims: Main Menu visibly rendered with New Game focused
owned Electron process, page, listener, and isolated profile closed cleanly
unprovenClaims: public Helios Station waypoint and autopilot approach
complete menu to Ledger Electron sanity verdict
informational_contended_note: Phase H1 ran contended by design. Timestamps and timeout controls are diagnostics only and are not performance evidence.
